findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Customers check you online before they pay you. " → 4 lines (24 words, 92.5px); "None of this is about how good you are. It's abo" → 3 lines (42 words, 44px); "What" → 3 lines (1 words, 64px); "Let's see what your business could look like. Le" → 4 lines (16 words, 64px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 24 words ("Customers check you online before they pay you. What are the"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 15 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Websites · AI agents · Digital products" above "Customers check you online before they p"; "Sound familiar?" above "Things we hear every single week. Things"; "What changes" above "What"; "Trust" above "People trust you before they talk to you"; "Found" above "Customers find you, not your competitor."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 16 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Websites · AI agents · Digital products", "Sound familiar?", "What changes", "Trust").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 4 gradient fill(s): div.glow.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.28), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.06) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.glow.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.28), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.06) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.glow.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.28), rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.06) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 17 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.55) 0px 10px 40px -12px | li.card.card-hover → rgba(245, 241, 232, 0.04) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 0px 30px 60p | li.card.card-hover → rgba(245, 241, 232, 0.04) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 0px 30px 60p
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 18 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): ul.divide-y.divide-onyx-600 579px | li.flex.items-start 579px | li.flex.items-start 579px | ul.group/list.mt-12 1320px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 15 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #f5f1e8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 4 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 424px at 5788px; 388px at 6904px; 412px at 10196px; 428px at 14000px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (60px, 220px, 199px, 409px, 117px, 858px, 230px); the three most used hold only 42% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Built" (screen 6, 50% hidden); "for" (screen 6, 38% hidden); "people" (screen 6, 38% hidden); "like" (screen 6, 38% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The margins differ: 34px on the left, 21px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 3 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: ""People say my prices are too " (0px from the right); "Fashion brand founder" (0px from the right); "Companies" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
